title.zh: 在北拉瑙省Maigo市镇设立国立中学，名称为Maigo国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Maigo Province of Lanao Del Norte, to Be Known as the Maigo National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Maigo Province of Lanao Del Norte, to Be Known as the Maigo National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Thị trấn Maigo Province of Lanao Del Norte được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Maigo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในเทศบาล Maigo Province of Lanao Del Norte ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Maigo
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Kotamadya Maigo Province of Lanao Del Norte dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Maigo
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Maigo Province of Lanao Del Norte dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Maigo

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7732_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay Poblacion in the Municipality of Maigo Province of Lanao del Norte, to be known as the Maigo National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

The Amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be funded out of the appropriations authorized by Republic Act No. 7663 for the Department of Education, Culture of Sports intended for the operational expenses of newly legislated high schools. Thereafter, the amount needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the Annual General Appropriation Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 3, 1994.
